name: Amanatides-Woo Grid Picking
definition: A method to pick grid cells by traversing a 2D grid using a Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) ray traversal algorithm, replacing expensive raycasting against terrain meshes. It determines the cell and face ('top' or 'side') hit by a ray, handling voids and raised terrain.
summary: Amanatides-Woo Grid Picking is a fast, exact method for ray-grid intersection that uses logical height maps instead of detailed meshes to ensure decorative geometry does not affect results.
